meta.title: Self-Compassion (SCS-SF)
meta.subtitle: How you treat yourself in hard moments.
meta.description: Twelve statements about how you usually relate to yourself when things are hard. The score is a mean from 1 to 5. The higher it is, the kinder you are to yourself. Self-Compassion Scale – Short Form (Raes, Pommier, Neff & Van Gucht, 2011), used with the author's permission.
meta.disclaimer: This tool supports self-reflection and tracking change. It does not diagnose and does not replace a consultation with a professional.

consent.title: Consent and disclaimer
consent.body: I understand this is a self-reflection tool, not a clinical test, and I agree to store my results locally on this device.

interpretation.low: In hard moments you tend to treat yourself harshly rather than kindly.
interpretation.medium: Kindness towards yourself alternates with self-criticism.
interpretation.high: In hard moments you usually treat yourself with kindness and understanding.

scs_01.m: When I fail at something important to me I become consumed by feelings of inadequacy.
scs_01.f: When I fail at something important to me I become consumed by feelings of inadequacy.

scs_02.m: I try to be understanding and patient towards those aspects of my personality I don't like.
scs_02.f: I try to be understanding and patient towards those aspects of my personality I don't like.

items.scs_03: When something painful happens I try to take a balanced view of the situation.
items.scs_04: When I'm feeling down I tend to feel like most other people are probably happier than I am.
items.scs_05: I try to see my failings as part of the human condition.
items.scs_06: When I'm going through a very hard time, I give myself the caring and tenderness I need.
items.scs_07: When something upsets me I try to keep my emotions in balance.

scs_08.m: When I fail at something that's important to me, I tend to feel alone in my failure.
scs_08.f: When I fail at something that's important to me, I tend to feel alone in my failure.

items.scs_09: When I'm feeling down I tend to obsess and fixate on everything that's wrong.
items.scs_10: When I feel inadequate in some way, I try to remind myself that feelings of inadequacy are shared by most people.
items.scs_11: I'm disapproving and judgmental about my own flaws and inadequacies.

scs_12.m: I'm intolerant and impatient towards those aspects of my personality I don't like.
scs_12.f: I'm intolerant and impatient towards those aspects of my personality I don't like.
